## QuantFunc MiniMax-H3

- **QuantFunc MiniMax-H3 Loader** replaces the official `Load Diffusion Model` (UNETLoader): the QuantFunc engine runs the H3 transformer, video and audio; the text encoder (`CLIPLoader`, type `minimax`), the video and audio VAEs and the sampler stay stock ComfyUI.
- `transformer` from ModelScope [QuantFunc/Minimax-H3-Quantfunc-4bit](https://modelscope.cn/models/QuantFunc/Minimax-H3-Quantfunc-4bit), in `models/diffusion_models`: `minimax_h3_ref2va_8steps_quantfunc_int4_r128.safetensors`.
- From Hugging Face [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3): text encoder `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors` (the bf16 file also works), VAEs `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors` and `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors`.
- `audio_enhance`: ON adds a short extra pass that makes the sound clearer (most useful at few steps). It is not supported in two-stage (double-sampling) workflows: it is ignored there.
- Input images: `red_superboy_on_city_roof.png`, `mecha_dragon_lightning.png` from [Comfy-Org/workflow_templates](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/tree/main/input); use your own.
- Size: 960x544 (multiples of 32), 124 frames (~5 s at 24 fps; frames are 17k+5).

**Reference images to video with audio.** `<Picture 1>` and `<Picture 2>` in the prompt are the reference images in order (up to more: connect another image to the next `ref_image` input). 8 steps, res_multistep / simple.

**Two stages: low-res, then upscaled high-res.** Stage 1 renders the whole clip on a small canvas (960x544, `Stage 1 steps`: 8). Its frames are decoded, scaled to `High-res width` x `High-res height` (1920x1088) and encoded again; the stage 1 audio is carried over (`Concat AV Latent`). Stage 2 adds noise back to the middle of its own schedule and refines the full canvas (`Stage 2 steps`: 4 steps from denoise 0.5). Higher denoise changes more; lower keeps stage 1 closer. `Stage 1 frames (preview)` shows stage 1. Edit the prompt and the length once, in `Prompt` and `Length (frames)`. For a quicker look, set the stage 1 canvas to 512x288 and the high-res size to 960x544.

widgets_values: Bold comic-book ink style, heavy linework, red and blue-black palette, night city. Use <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> as references. CUT 1: the little red-caped superhero boy from <Picture 1> stands on a rooftop, hands on his hips, grins at the camera and shouts "Get ready!". CUT 2: the giant black mech-kaiju from <Picture 2> rears back and ROARS, red chest core flaring, blue lightning arcing off its head, thunder rumbling over the skyline.
